paragraphs.text: Tyreus is a Ravnican planeswalker that was introduced in the lore accompanying Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms . He is the grandson of Sylvene .

Tyreus' grandmother once visited the Forgotten Realms . She fell in love with a local man and built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her creation . Sylvene was pregnant when her husband died, and she gave birth to their son, Tyberio, in Waterdeep . She eventually returned to Ravnica to raise him, and she passed away when Tyberio was twelve.

Tyberio rebelled by refusing to study magic. He sought a quiet life as a craftsman and merchant but carried a certain bitterness and resentment toward the world of Ravnica. He always wanted to visit the land where his parents had met but never managed to. Tyberio started a family with his wife, Ayraea, and had one son. In bitterness, Tyberio forbade his son from studying magic — but it didn’t work. As a teenager, Tyreus secretly began learning the ways of mages the same summer that, coincidentally, Tyberio and Ayraea passed away from a minor plague.

Furious over his parents’ fears of magic, their death, and his powerlessness, Tyreus devoted his life to magic thereafter. He managed to planeswalk to the Realms in pursuit of legends and lore, in the footsteps of his grandmother.

Although it was explicitly stated that the Dungeons & Dragons setting of the Forgotten Realms is not considered to be canonically part of Magic' s Multiverse , the Magic Story released with the set mixed the flavor anyway.
